snippet.title: Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV – Nintendo Direct
snippet.description:
Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV launches for Nintendo Switch 2 on July 24, 2025. Pre-order the upgrade pack today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-mario-party-jamboree-nintendo-switch-2-edition-plus-jamboree-tv-upgrade-pack-switch-2/?utm_source=HW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1001-01&utm_id=S1001-01

Super Mario Party Jamboree is getting even more minigames and an upgrade on Nintendo Switch 2! The upgrade expands on the base game and adds Nintendo Switch 2 gameplay features, such as mouse controls, enhanced rumble, sound recognition, and modes that use a camera accessory (sold separately). Nintendo Switch 2 players who already own Super Mario Party Jamboree can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV by purchasing an upgrade pack.

Watch more Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV gameplay from Nintendo Treehouse: Live | Nintendo Switch 2:
➤ https://youtu.be/sDapFg1BlZE

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
